name: Saul Stein
bio: Saul Stein is an actor and producer, known for Dead Man Down (2013), Open Water (2003) and Money Train (1995).

credits.title: I Play Rocky
credits.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

credits.title: Silent Partners
credits.overview: In 1980s Miami, Valentine, a psychotic hitman seeks freedom by hijacking the Chicago Outfit's insurance scam. Partnering with enemies and pursued by a justice-driven undercover cop, a silent collaboration may be more deadly than lucrative.

credits.title: Café Society
credits.overview: The story of a young man who arrives in Hollywood during the 1930s hoping to work in the film industry, falls in love, and finds himself swept up in the vibrant café society that defined the spirit of the age.

credits.title: Run
credits.overview: A street smart, 17-year-old named Daniel practices Parkour and is both hero and thief.

credits.title: Dead Man Down
credits.overview: In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.

credits.title: The Grasslands
credits.overview: Ciro, a Bronx hood whose sense of loyalty is being tested after he's accused of killing one of his partners. Haunted by his fathers unsolved murder twenty years earlier, Ciro is conflicted with protecting the people (Chuck Zito, Peter Greene) who have always looked out for him.

credits.title: Arthur
credits.overview: A drunken playboy stands to lose a wealthy inheritance when he falls for a woman that his family doesn't like.

credits.title: The Ministers
credits.overview: A NYPD detective attempts to avenge the death of her father, but unwittingly becomes involved with one of his killers.

credits.title: Tenderness
credits.overview: A hardened cop tries to unravel the past to discover whether a violent teenager was responsible for the murder of his family. A confused fifteen-year-old runaway becomes enthralled with the young man.

credits.title: The Narrows
credits.overview: A 19 year old Brooklyn boy who is torn between two worlds when his photography portfolio wins him a partial scholarship to NYU. credits.title: Open Water
credits.overview: Two divers are left out at sea without a boat. There’s nothing but water for miles, unless they look at what’s underneath them...

credits.title: WiseGirls
credits.overview: Meg, Raychel and Kate are three waitresses at a restaurant frequented by mob bosses. Their lives become complicated when one of the women witnesses a crime, and the three friends suddenly find themselves entangled in their customers’ dangerous world.

credits.title: Under the Influence
credits.overview: Murder, deceit, fraud. Another perfect day in Los Angeles. Camilla Overbye Roos (On the Border) won Best Actress at the NY Independent Film Festival for her starring role in Under the Influence. Co-star Peter Greene is best-known as Zed from Pulp Fiction.

credits.title: Bridget
credits.overview: Being addicted to alcohol, single mother Anna had to give her son to foster parents, but they would "sell" him back if she offers enough money. When she gets to know Pete, the mentally handicapped son of a wealthy author, his father asks her to marry his son for one million dollar.

credits.title: The Holy Land
credits.overview: A coming-of-age saga set against the tense backdrop of Arab-Israeli politics. Mendy is a young Rabbinical student whose mind is too full of curiosity about the world that exists outside the restrictions of Orthodox Judaism. credits.title: Fast Food Fast Women
credits.overview: How important is the truth when falling in love? Bella is a Manhattan café waitress, about to turn 35, stuck in a long-term affair going nowhere. credits.title: Two Family House
credits.overview: Buddy Visalo (Michael Rispoli) is a factory worker, a frustrated crooner who once had a shot at the big time. Buddy's dreams of greatness have been reduced to an endless series of failed moneymaking schemes. credits.title: Kiss Toledo Goodbye
credits.overview: After learning his biological father was a crime lord, an Ohio investment adviser must secretly try to prevent a gang war.

credits.title: He Got Game
credits.overview: A basketball player's father must try to convince him to go to a college so he can get a shorter prison sentence.

credits.title: Pink as the Day She Was Born
credits.overview: A rock-n-roll sex comedy about a young girl who will do anything to become a rock star, working in an LA domination parlor to support herself.

credits.title: Grind
credits.overview: When a drag-racing, hard-luck parolee moves in with his brother in hopes of that ever-elusive fresh start in life, he's sure to be warm for the form of his brother's bored young wife. Things only get worse when he tries to turn a quick buck in a one-time insurance fraud operation.

credits.title: No Way Home
credits.overview: An ex-con's future is threatened by his brother's involvement with drugs.

credits.title: Illtown
credits.overview: Two young lovers are torn between their part-time criminal activity and the enticement of family and home.

credits.title: Money Train
credits.overview: When a vengeful New York transit cop decides to steal a trainload of subway fares, his foster brother—a fellow cop—tries to protect him.

credits.title: New Jersey Drive
credits.overview: Jason and Midget are two young, black teenagers living in Newark, New Jersey, the unofficial car theft capital of the world. credits.title: Laws of Gravity
credits.overview: The lives of two incompetent young men from Brooklyn spin out of control after a friend returns from Florida with guns to sell.

credits.title: Beer
credits.overview: An advertising firm, desperate to keep an account from a financially-ailing brewery, concocts a macho ad campaign centering on three losers who inadvertently prevent a robbery at a bar.
